pairings.hebrew: כְּמַהְפֵּכַת סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה וּשְׁכֵנֶיהָ אָמַר יְהוָה לֹא־יֵשֵׁב שָׁם אִישׁ וְלֹא־יָגוּר בָּהּ בֶּן־אָדָם׃
pairings.english: Concerning Ammon's people, thus says YHWH: Has Israel no sons, no heir? Why has their king possessed Gad, and his people settled in its cities?
pairings.reason: Hebrew is MT 49:18 (כְּמַהְפֵּכַת סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה וּשְׁכֵנֶיהָ, 'as at the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah'); English renders MT 49:1, the Ammon heading.

pairings.hebrew: מִקּוֹל נִפְלָם רָעֲשָׁה הָאָרֶץ צְעָקָה בְּיַם־סוּף נִשְׁמַע קוֹלָהּ׃
pairings.english: Therefore days are coming—YHWH's declaration—when I will make the battle cry heard against Rabbah of Ammon's people. She will become a desolate mound, her daughters will be burned with fire, and Israel will possess those who possessed him, says YHWH.
pairings.reason: Hebrew is MT 49:21 (מִקּוֹל נִפְלָם רָעֲשָׁה הָאָרֶץ, 'at the sound of their fall the earth quakes'); English renders MT 49:2, the battle cry against Rabbah.

pairings.hebrew: מִקּוֹל נִפְלָם רָעֲשָׁה הָאָרֶץ צְעָקָה בְּיַם־סוּף נִשְׁמַע קוֹלָהּ׃
pairings.english: Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is devastated! Cry out, daughters of Rabbah; put on sackcloth, mourn, and wander among the enclosures. For their king will go into exile, his priests and officials together.
pairings.reason: Hebrew is MT 49:21 (מִקּוֹל נִפְלָם רָעֲשָׁה הָאָרֶץ צְעָקָה בְּיַם־סוּף, earth quakes, cry at the Sea of Reeds); English renders MT 49:3, 'Wail, Heshbon'.

pairings.hebrew: לָכֵן שִׁמְעוּ עֲצַת־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר יָעַץ אֶל־אֱדוֹם וּמַחְשְׁבוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר חָשַׁב אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵי תֵימָן אִם־לֹא יִסְחָבוּם צְעִירֵי הַצֹּאן אִם־לֹא יַשִּׁים עֲלֵיהֶם נְוֵהֶם׃
pairings.english: Why do you boast in the valleys—your valley flows away—rebellious daughter, trusting in her treasures, saying, Who will come against me?
pairings.reason: Hebrew is MT 49:20 (לָכֵן שִׁמְעוּ עֲצַת־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר יָעַץ אֶל־אֱדוֹם, 'hear YHWH's counsel against Edom'); English renders MT 49:4, boasting in the valleys.

pairings.hebrew: אָהֳלֵיהֶם וְצֹאנָם יִקָּחוּ יְרִיעוֹתֵיהֶם וְכָל־כְּלֵיהֶם וּגְמַלֵּיהֶם יִשְׂאוּ לָהֶם וְקָרְאוּ עֲלֵיהֶם מָגוֹר מִסָּבִיב׃
pairings.english: I am bringing terror upon you—declares Lord YHWH of hosts—from all around you. You will be driven away, each straight ahead, and no one will gather the wanderer.
pairings.reason: Hebrew is MT 49:29 (אָהֳלֵיהֶם וְצֹאנָם יִקָּחוּ, 'their tents and flocks they will take'); English renders MT 49:5, terror brought on Ammon.

pairings.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה חָצוֹר לִמְעוֹן תַּנִּים שְׁמָמָה עַד־עוֹלָם לֹא־יֵשֵׁב שָׁם אִישׁ וְלֹא־יָגוּר בָּהּ בֶּן־אָדָם׃

pairings.hebrew: קוּמוּ עֲלוּ אֶל־גּוֹי שְׁלֵיו יוֹשֵׁב לָבֶטַח נְאֻם־יְהוָה לֹא־דְלָתַיִם וְלֹא־בְרִיחַ לוֹ בָּדָד יִשְׁכֹּנוּ׃
pairings.english: How has the city of praise not been abandoned, the town of my joy?

pairings.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת הִנְנִי שֹׁבֵר אֶת־קֶשֶׁת עֵילָם רֵאשִׁית גְּבוּרָתָם׃
pairings.english: Therefore her young men will fall in her squares, and all the fighting men will be silenced that day—declares YHWH of hosts.

pairings.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה חָצוֹר לִמְעוֹן תַּנִּים שְׁמָמָה עַד־עוֹלָם לֹא־יֵשֵׁב שָׁם אִישׁ וְלֹא־יָגוּר בָּהּ בֶּן־אָדָם׃

pairings.english: Thus says YHWH, Israel's God, concerning you, Baruch:

pairings.english: He will turn his face toward the coastlands and capture many. But a commander will end his insolence; indeed, he will turn his insolence back upon him.
pairings.reason: Hebrew shown is 11:19 (וְיָשֵׁב פָּנָיו לְמָעוּזֵּי אַרְצוֹ וְנִכְשַׁל וְנָפַל, repeated at unit 40); the English renders MT 11:18 (וְיָשֵׁב פָּנָיו לְאִיִּים וְלָכַד רַבִּים וְהִשְׁבִּית קָצִין חֶרְפָּתוֹ …).
